sentences.text:
1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of accordingly.
3. The present application under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks the following prayers:

"It is, therefore, most humbly and respectfully prayed that in the light of above mentioned facts and circumstances and settlement, your Lordship may graciously be pleased to quash the FIR No.347 /2020 under section 498A/406/34 IPC PS Alipur,
Delhi and also its proceedings, if any, in the interest of justice."
4. Issue notice.
